description: A script designed to automatically fix common linting issues such as unused exception variables and unused result variables in specific router files within a codebase.

methods.name: fix_unused_exception_variables(file_path)
methods.description: Reads a Python source file, detects unused exception variables and result variables, and modifies the content to clean up linting issues.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that iterates over predefined router file paths and applies lint fixes if they exist.
